# Lead-time sensitivity at equal fill rate, main window (generated by code/leadtime_equal_fill.py)

R = 1, no liquidation, forecasts for h = L + 1. Row LGB-Q: inventory needed (weeks of demand). Other rows: Δ vs LGB-Q in % with 95% bootstrap CI over series (positive = LGB-Q needs less). '—' = target not reached. HGB-Q not included (no forecasts at h = 2 and 5). C2 = mean of the LGB-Q and TSB-NB quantiles.
